description: List ALL ISINs (securities) issued by a legal entity, from the official GLEIF ISIN-to-LEI mapping. Accepts a 20-character LEI or a company NAME (resolved automatically and echoed back). Answers "what securities has this company issued" / "all ISINs for Nestlé". Returns the full set — bonds, share lines, ADRs — not a single value; an entity that exists but has no mapped ISINs returns an empty set with that stated.

lei.description: 20-character LEI code (e.g. "KY37LUS27QQX7BB93L28") OR a company name (e.g. "Nestlé") — names are resolved via the LEI registry first.

name: lei_to_isins
title: Lei To Isins
